justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/Evaluator.java` and `src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java`. `IsFirstOfType` is a tiny nested class at lines 545-552 with only a no-arg constructor and `toString()`, and it inherits all matching logic from `IsNthOfType` (lines 654-677), so it has a single responsibility rather than enough independent behavior to warrant decomposition. `QueryParser` only instantiates it for the `:first-of-type` pseudo-class (line 244), confirming it is a focused adapter, not a large or low-cohesion unit.
